exposure: mode of delivery (spontaneous, elective LSCS, emergency LSCS)
outcome: spectrum of CHD types (ASD, PFO, PDA, Complex congenital heart disease, TOF)
cohort: Neonates admitted in the neonatal intermediate care unit of Kanti Children's Hospital, Nepal.
finding: The prevalence of CHD was 102.28 per 1000 admitted neonates, with Atrial Septal Defect (ASD) being the most common type and respiratory distress the commonest presentation.
mod_finding: The mode of delivery for neonates with CHD was spontaneous in 71.8%, elective LSCS in 14.1%, and emergency LSCS in 9.4%.
